title: GMX Solana (GMTrade) — residual unprivileged extraction
closed_reasons: Deployed store program is the audited revision: instruction surface exactly equals audit commit 8af1e70 (134/134 present in ELF discriminator scan; 134/134 recognized by on-chain simulate probe); all 5 post-audit instructions return InstructionFallbackNotFound (101).

Oracle price-setting (set_prices_from_price_feed) requires the signer to be the oracle authority AND hold ORACLE_CONTROLLER role; a self-created store-bound oracle still reverts with PermissionDenied (6004).
All value-moving protocol paths are role-gated via #[access_control]: execute_*/liquidate = ORDER_KEEPER, market/GT/treasury/feature/config = their keepers/admin.
Ungated instructions are either read-only getters, owner-scoped (owner: Signer + UserHeader PDA has_one = owner), or inert account creation.
Treasury fee claiming requires treasury.is_receiver(authority); transfer_receiver is restricted to the current receiver; accept_receiver requires the designated next_receiver to sign.
Action closers constrain receiver/rent_receiver to the recorded values (owner) — no rent/output redirection.
Store/treasury/timelock/competition/liquidity-provider share an off-curve PDA upgrade authority; callback and gt-incentive programs are not deployed on mainnet.

caveats: Exact deployed commit not pinned among 8 candidates sharing the identical instruction+string surface (8af1e70..6cc72716); those differ only in backward-compatible data-layout fields, not in any access gate.

A full reproducible SBF build is environment-sensitive (embedded /home/runner sysroot paths), so an exact ELF-hash match is impractical; the discriminator/string/on-chain diff is the load-bearing evidence.
claim_fees/liquidate probes revert at account validation before their named gate; those gates are established from source plus analogous clean NotAnAdmin/PermissionDenied probes.
TVL is DefiLlama's figure, not an independent per-vault recount.
P (privileged) bucket is the protocol TVL exposed to keeper/admin/upgrade keys; it is not attacker-extractable.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from GMX Solana: the deployed store program is the audited revision (instruction surface = commit 8af1e70) and every value-moving path is role-gated (ORACLE_CONTROLLER for prices, ORDER_KEEPER for execution, admin for authority); on-chain simulateTransaction probes confirm the attacker holds no role and all candidate paths revert.
